2607.15202.title: Self-Evolving Human-Centered Framework for Explainable Depression Symptom Annotation
2607.15202.paper_summary: Annotation quality is a major bottleneck in building reliable and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) systems for mental health research. In depression-related datasets, labels are often assigned without structured evidence, symptom-level justification, or traceable alignment with the criteria of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition, Text Revision (DSM-5-TR), limiting both transparency and downstream model interpretability. We propose a self-evolving, expert-in-the-loop annotation framework for Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) that combines large language model (LLM)-assisted labeling with expert verification. The framework is intended to support the construction of explainable, DSM-5-TR-aligned datasets rather than to perform clinical diagnosis. It operates in three stages: candidate evidence selection from textual records, criterion-level DSM-5-TR analysis, and case-level synthesis that produces label-level diagnostic and severity annotations. A dual-memory architecture, composed of Example Memory and Reflection Memory, is designed to internalize expert feedback and iteratively improve future annotations without retraining. We describe this mechanism and leave its evaluation across multiple feedback cycles to future work. In addition to final labels, the framework exports clinical evidence, reasoning traces, and edit histories, enabling comprehensive auditability. In a pilot study using expert-reviewed samples, the proposed approach improves annotation consistency and explainability while reducing manual revision effort.
2607.15202.paper_summary_zh: 註解質量是建立可靠且可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）系統在心理健康研究中的主要瓶頸。在與抑鬱症相關的數據集中，標籤通常是在沒有結構化證據、症狀級別的理由或與《精神疾病診斷與統計手冊》第五版文本修訂版（DSM-5-TR）標準可追溯對齊的情況下分配的，這限制了透明度和下游模型的可解釋性。我們提出了一個自我演進的專家參與註解框架，用於重度抑鬱症（MDD），該框架結合了大型語言模型（LLM）輔助標記和專家驗證。該框架旨在支持構建可解釋的、與DSM-5-TR對齊的數據集，而不是進行臨床診斷。它分為三個階段：從文本記錄中選擇候選證據、進行標準級別的DSM-5-TR分析，以及生成標籤級別的診斷和嚴重性註解的案例級別綜合。雙記憶架構由示例記憶和反思記憶組成，旨在內化專家反饋並在不重新訓練的情況下迭代改進未來的註解。我們描述了這一機制，並將其在多個反饋循環中的評估留給未來的工作。除了最終標籤外，該框架還導出臨床證據、推理痕跡和編輯歷史，實現全面的可審計性。在一項使用專家審核樣本的試點研究中，所提出的方法提高了註解的一致性和可解釋性，同時減少了手動修訂的工作量。
